name: Santee
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Santee, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Santee, CA: Starlight Circle lights, a Water Lantern Festival and Grinch painting at Santee Lakes, and a holiday art camp.
lede: Santee lights its tree at Santee Trolley Square, then spends December at Santee Lakes and on Starlight Circle, where a whole neighborhood decorates for visitors.
celebrates: The City of Santee starts the season with its Holiday Lighting at Santee Trolley Square, a free evening with live music, sledding, Santa photos and a tree lighting at 6:15 pm. In December the residents of the Starlight Circle neighborhood light up their homes for visitors, and the city posts parking and walking tips while reminding families that the display is free. Santee Lakes hosts holiday painting classes on The Deck and a holiday edition of the Water Lantern Festival, where families launch lanterns on the water. Local studios such as Heart Art add Christmas classes and a winter break art camp.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Santee held its Holiday Lighting on Friday, November 21, from 5:30 to 8:30 pm at Santee Trolley Square, 9884 Mission Gorge Road. The city calendar listed it as free and for all ages, with live music by the band Upstream, face painting, holiday photo opportunities and the tree lighting. The city ran the evening itself, listed 619-258-4100 for questions and posted updates on its Instagram and Facebook pages.
facts: Santee did not start out as Santee. The town was first called Cowleston. Three years after Cowles died in 1887, his widow Jennie married Milton Santee, a realtor and surveyor, and in 1893 the community changed the town's name to Santee. For years the area was governed by the county, and residents had turned down becoming a city, but in 1980 they reversed themselves and voted to incorporate the City of Santee.
trains: Santee sits at the end of the MTS trolley line. To reach the city's Holiday Lighting at Santee Trolley Square, MTS tells riders to take the Green or Orange Line to El Cajon and transfer to the Copper Line to Santee, and it offers free parking at its Park and Ride lots. For a real Christmas train, the Pacific Southwest Railway Museum in Campo runs its North Pole Limited in East County, and the Poway-Midland Railroad gives short rides at Old Poway Park.

kidfact: Santee was once called Cowleston. It got its new name in 1893 after a widow named Jennie Cowles married a surveyor named Milton Santee.
faq: When is the Santee tree lighting?

The City of Santee holds its Holiday Lighting at Santee Trolley Square on a Friday evening in late November, from 5:30 to 8:30 pm, with the tree lit at 6:15 pm. In 2025 it fell on November 21. The city lists it as free for all ages, with live music, face painting and holiday photo spots.
Is Starlight Circle in Santee free to visit?

Yes. The City of Santee says the Starlight Circle display is free and asks visitors not to pay anyone to view the lights. The display is run by the neighborhood residents, not the city. Families can walk or drive through, and free parking is available at Santana High School next door.
What Christmas events happen at Santee Lakes?

Santee Lakes lists holiday painting classes on The Deck, such as a Merry Grinchmas paint party and a reindeer canvas, and it hosts a holiday edition of the Water Lantern Festival. Parking at Santee Lakes is paid, and each event sells its own tickets through the organizer.
Can we take the trolley to Santee?

Yes. MTS tells riders heading to Santee Trolley Square to take the Green or Orange Line to El Cajon and transfer to the Copper Line to Santee. For the holiday lighting, MTS strongly recommended transit because parking is limited, and it offers free parking at its Park and Ride lots.
